info.name: Materials Project Defect Tasks Materials Phonon API

params.name: material_ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of material_id values to query on

params.name: formula
params.description: Query by formula including anonymized formula or by including wild cards. A comma delimited string list of anonymous formulas or regular formulas can also be provided.

params.name: chemsys
params.description: A comma delimited string list of chemical systems. Wildcards for unknown elements only supported for single chemsys queries

params.name: elements
params.description: Query by elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: exclude_elements
params.description: Query by excluded elements in the material composition as a comma-separated list

params.name: crystal_system
params.description: Crystal system of the material. If a comma-separated string, will query by multiple crystal systems.

params.name: spacegroup_number
params.description: Space group number of the material. If a comma-separated string, will query by multiple space group numbers.

params.name: spacegroup_symbol
params.description: Space group symbol of the material. If a comma-separated string, will query by multiple space group numbers.

params.name: phonon_method
params.description: Phonon Method to search for

params.name: nsites_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of nsites

params.name: nsites_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of nsites

params.name: nsites
params.description: Query for nsites being equal to an exact value

params.name: nsites_not_eq
params.description: Query for nsites being not equal to an exact value

params.name: nsites_eq_any
params.description: Query for nsites being any of these values. Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: nsites_neq_any
params.description: Query for nsites being not any of these values.                             Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: nelements_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of nelements

params.name: nelements_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of nelements

params.name: nelements
params.description: Query for nelements being equal to an exact value

params.name: nelements_not_eq
params.description: Query for nelements being not equal to an exact value

params.name: nelements_eq_any
params.description: Query for nelements being any of these values. Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: nelements_neq_any
params.description: Query for nelements being not any of these values.                             Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: volume_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of volume

params.name: volume_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of volume

params.name: density_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of density

params.name: density_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of density

params.name: density_atomic_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of density_atomic

params.name: density_atomic_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of density_atomic

params.name: total_dft_energy_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of total_dft_energy

params.name: total_dft_energy_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of total_dft_energy

params.name: volume_per_formula_unit_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of volume_per_formula_unit

params.name: volume_per_formula_unit_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of volume_per_formula_unit

params.name: formula_units_max
params.description: Query for maximum value of formula_units

params.name: formula_units_min
params.description: Query for minimum value of formula_units

params.name: formula_units
params.description: Query for formula_units being equal to an exact value

params.name: formula_units_not_eq
params.description: Query for formula_units being not equal to an exact value

params.name: formula_units_eq_any
params.description: Query for formula_units being any of these values. Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: formula_units_neq_any
params.description: Query for formula_units being not any of these values.                             Provide a comma separated list.

params.name: _page
params.description: Page number to request (takes precedent over _limit and _skip).

params.name: _per_page
params.description: Number of entries to show per page (takes precedent over _limit and _skip). Limited to 1000.

params.name: _skip
params.description: Number of entries to skip in the search.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Max number of entries to return in a single query. Limited to 1000.

params.name: _fields
params.description: Fields to project from PhononBSDOSDoc as a list of comma separated strings.                    Fields include: `nsites` `elements` `nelements` `composition` `composition_reduced` `formula_pretty` `formula_anonymous` `chemsys` `volume` `density` `density_atomic` `symmetry` `identifier` `phonon_method` `phonon_bandstructure` `phonon_dos` `epsilon_static` `epsilon_electronic` `born` `force_constants` `last_updated` `sum_rules_breaking` `structure` `total_dft_energy` `volume_per_formula_unit` `formula_units` `supercell_matrix` `primitive_matrix` `code` `post_process_settings` `thermal_displacement_data` `calc_meta` `material_id` `task_ids`

params.name: _all_fields
params.description: Include all fields.
